verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents setting up several pay schedules or frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), or assigning them to different teams. The closest items are about other things: recurring payroll automation (RUN & DONE), multi-state pay within one pay period, and multi-company reports. None of these shows support for multiple concurrent pay schedules.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
